decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the firm's core pipeline business and moved from a mention to its own page in 2019, so its results likely meet aspirations and give no reason to search for alternatives.

The powder-coated waste bin is far from the core business, but it reuses the firm's coating capacity and serves the same municipal customers, and industry growth provides slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain.

This multi-model waste bin line with ashtray uses existing coating and fabrication capability for municipal buyers, so with growing turnover providing slack the firm is likely to keep it despite its distance from the core.

Outdoor ashtrays are the most peripheral item, overlapping with the waste-bin-with-ashtray line, so a likely shortfall against aspirations would prompt problemistic search and moving the resources back to core pipeline work.
